dt-example.title: Bootstrap 4
dt-example.info:
This example shows how StateRestore extension integrates with the [Bootstrap 4](https://getbootstrap.com/docs/4.6/) styling library. This example makes use of the `-button statesTable` button to display the state list, but `-button statesList` can also be used with seamless integration.
Note that the other StateRestore examples will operate with any styling framework - use the options list at the top right of your page to select the framework you'd like to see, so you can see all of StatesRestore's features with your preferred styling.
